Taylor: Hi! I'm Taylor (infra-new hire). Trying to finish dev bootstrap on an M2. Problems: `asdf install nodejs lts` fails with OpenSSL link errors, Homebrew shows libs under /opt/homebrew but the build can't find headers. Also the GitHub invite went to my personal email and SSO rejects it. Who approves org access and VPN?

Noah: welcome! For M1/M2 we set env vars so builds find brew openssl:
export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib/pkgconfig"
then retry `asdf`. If you accidentally installed Homebrew under Rosetta, make sure `which brew` points to `/opt/homebrew`. Use `arch -arm64 asdf install ...` to force native builds.

Taylor: I did install brew via Rosetta earlier. Best path to switch to native without reinstalling everything?

Noah: easiest is reinstall Homebrew natively or invoke the native binary at `/opt/homebrew/bin/brew`. You can also prefix installs with `arch -arm64`. For fish: add `eval "$(direnv export bash)"` to config.fish so direnv works.

Molly: For the SSO invite — mine went to the wrong email too. Ping @Claire (infra) with your GitHub username and preferred email and she can reissue the invite and approve SSO/VPN. They need your laptop serial and manager name for audit.

Claire (infra): Confirmed. To request GitHub org + VPN access open a ticket in #help titled "New hire access: GitHub + VPN" and include full name, GitHub handle, laptop serial (or type), office/location, and manager. Typical response time a few hours. If you need temporary repo access now DM me and I can add a deploy key.

DevX-Bot: Quick checklist: 1) `asdf plugin-update --all` 2) `gpg --recv-keys <id>` if plugin asks 3) set OpenSSL env vars (see above) 4) `eval $(op signin redwood --raw)` then `op item get onboarding/ssh --fields label=password` 5) `ssh -T git@github.com` to validate. Docs: https://redwood-internal.dev/setup/devbox (VPN/SSO required).

Taylor: Thanks all 97 switching to native brew and filing the help ticket now. Will follow up here if the build still fails.
